W \u00b7 L.name: Wins · losses
W \u00b7 L.def: All games, including crossover and non-NCAA opponents

Poss.name: Possessions
Poss.def: FGA − OREB + TOV + 0.475 × FTA (a game's possessions average both teams)

Opp.name: Opponent
Opp.def: Prefix: the same stat for the team's opponents (defense)

Site.name: Site
Site.def: H home, A away, N neutral (neutral known for D1 games via ESPN)

Crossover.name: Crossover
Crossover.def: 1 when the teams are in different divisions or one is non-NCAA

QualityOK.name: Quality OK
QualityOK.def: 1 when the game passes box-score validation and counts toward ratings

AdjEM.name: Adjusted efficiency margin
AdjEM.def: AdjO − AdjD: points per 100 possessions better than an average team in the division, neutral court

AdjO.name: Adjusted offensive efficiency
AdjO.def: Points scored per 100 possessions against an average division opponent

AdjD.name: Adjusted defensive efficiency
AdjD.def: Points allowed per 100 possessions against an average division opponent (lower is better)

AdjT.name: Adjusted tempo
AdjT.def: Possessions per 40 minutes against an average opponent

NCSOS.name: Nonconference SOS
NCSOS.def: Average opponent AdjEM, nonconference in-division games

Luck.name: Luck
Luck.def: Actual wins − the sum of pregame win probabilities (in-division games)

Rk.name: Rank
Rk.def: Rank by AdjEM within the division; hover for the 80% range

Factor contribution.name: Points per 100 from each factor
Factor contribution.def: (Team factor − division average) × that factor's regression weight; the eight add up to roughly AdjEM

Watch.name: Watch Score
Watch.def: 0–100: 35% close game between good teams, 35% style extremes, 30% stakes

Win %.name: Win probability
Win %.def: Pregame probability from the ratings, frozen before tip

Usg%.name: Usage
Usg%.def: Share of team possessions he uses (FGA, 0.475 × FTA, TOV) while on the floor

%Shots.name: Shot share
%Shots.def: Share of team FGA while on the floor

DRB%.name: Defensive rebound %
DRB%.def: Share of available defensive rebounds grabbed while on the floor

Player AST%.name: Assist %
Player AST%.def: Share of teammates' FGM he assisted while on the floor

BLK%.name: Block %
BLK%.def: Blocks / opponent 2PA while on the floor

STL%.name: Steal %
STL%.def: Steals / opponent possessions while on the floor
